data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross strengthening of GBP 38.4 million in prior year reserves, representing a 67.24% increase relative to opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was primarily driven by unfavourable claims experience in Political Risks, Consumer Products, and Property classes. Specific issues included large loss notifications in the Political Risks credit book, adverse performance on certain large Consumer Products accounts, higher attrition in legacy European Creditor business, and an unfavourable settlement on a long-standing Property claim.

unfavourable development in a legacy Property claim
